description: Na₃LuSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LuO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one LuO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LuO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 75°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.51 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.57 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Lu sites. In the first Lu site, Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.20 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Lu-O bond lengths. In the second Lu site, Lu is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted LuO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Lu-O bond lengths are 2.24 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one LuO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.69 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms.
